company.name: Shezlong
company.shortDescription: Shezlong, an online mental health platform, allows patients to be connected with licensed therapists via video visit on mobiles or web.
company.description: Shezlong is the first and largest online psychotherapy platform that aims to giving people convenient and private access to professional counseling in Arabic. Founded in 2016 with more than 350 therapists and 100 thousands clients. We primarily target Arab-speaking natives who are mostly allocated within the MENA region. However, Shezlong has experienced significant traction from Arabs all around the world, hitting 85 countries, and still growing exponentially!. Shezlong is the one-stop mental wellness shop that people seek to feel better. Starting from reading detailed and scientific blogs to get guidance, taking psychometric tests to assess their current state, receiving recommendations on the most relevant therapists for your case and booking a session, that's all Shezlong. We're with you 24x7, and we're part of our patients daily routine. And to do that, we empower therapists to become more successful and get closer to their patients!

insights.title: Meaningful non-dilutive funding
insights.statement: 2 disclosed grants total $116,000, representing 17.42% of reported funding.
insights.implication: The grants reduce the share of reported financing attributed to equity or notes, although their restrictions and milestone requirements need separate verification.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $1,530,530 to $9,757,344, a 6.38x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 48 (-1 over 90 days) and market heat at 37 (+7).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.

insights.title: Competitive benchmark reflects the modeled peer set

insights.implication: These matches provide a starting point for comparing differentiation, scale, and shared specialties, but they should not be treated as a verified competitor set.
